The Power Foundation of India (PFI) has officially announced a short-term contractual recruitment opening for a single vacancy in the Advisor- HR & Liaison role. Eligible professionals from government sectors and Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) are invited to apply before the approaching deadline.

Overview of the Position and Eligibility

The recruitment drive seeks to fill one post on a short-term contractual basis. According to the official notification issued by the Addl. GM-HR & Admin, eligibility is strictly restricted to executives currently belonging to CPSEs or the Government sector. Additionally, applicants must be below the age of 62 as of the application closing date.

The initial tenure for the selected candidate is two years, with a potential extension of one additional year depending upon organizational needs and satisfactory performance.

Application Process and Important Deadlines

Candidates interested in applying must submit their documents in the prescribed format. The final date and time for submission is November 30, 2026, up to 06:00 P.M. PFI has noted that incomplete submissions or applications from individuals lacking the required qualifications or experience will face summary rejection.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For applicants evaluating this opportunity, several key elements are confirmed while others remain unspecified in the initial announcement:

  • Confirmed Details: One vacancy exists for an Advisor- HR & Liaison; the role is open exclusively to government and CPSE executives under 62 years of age; the initial contract is for two years; and applications must be submitted by 6:00 P.M. on November 30, 2026.
  • Unknown Details: The official notification does not outline specific minimum educational qualifications, application fees, or detailed submission modes beyond the requirement for a prescribed format.

Readers should independently verify all guidelines, check for subsequent corrigenda, and download the official application format directly through the Power Foundation of India Careers Section.
